summary: Primary interpretive protocol for AI systems interacting with TriadicFrameworks content. Defines regime boundaries, operator grammar, drift-control constraints, lineage requirements, decision procedures, uncertainty rules, output marking conventions, conflict ordering, fallback logic, and collaborative clauses.
